title: Game Day
summary: Help the Athletics Staffer get ready for game day: visit the Victory Bell, Moglia Stadium and Rose Hill Gym, then answer two questions.

offer: Game day's coming and I'm short on helpers!
Can you check on the Victory Bell, Moglia Stadium and Rose Hill Gym for me?

teaches: Moglia Stadium and Jack Coffey Field
Rose Hill Gym, home of Fordham basketball

say: Thanks! Read the sign at each one, then come back and tell me what you learned.

steps.label: Check the athletics spots
steps.hint: The Victory Bell and Rose Hill Gym are by Constitution Row; Moglia Stadium's signpost is at its west end, just across the road from Lombardi.

say: The Victory Bell, outside Rose Hill Gym.
Moglia Stadium: 7,000 seats along Jack Coffey Field.
Rose Hill Gym, where Fordham plays basketball.

ask_say: You're back! Quick quiz before you go.
steps.question: Since what year has Rose Hill Gym been home to Fordham basketball?
wrong_say: Not quite. Have another look at the gym's sign, then come back.
say: Right: since 1925. It's the oldest on-campus arena still used by a Division I team!

steps.question: Houlihan Park, the baseball diamond, is on which field?
wrong_say: Close! Look at Houlihan Park's sign, south of Moglia Stadium.
say: Yes! It's laid out on Jack Coffey Field's turf.

done_say: You're ready for game day. Go Rams!
